name: SPINACH-derived English Answer-Set Consistency Benchmark
description: English benchmark subset derived from SPARQL-based question seeds. The file contains 150 benchmark items with four related questions and an optional type label for the benchmark relation pattern.

distribution.name: SPINACH English benchmark TSV
distribution.description: 150 benchmark items derived from SPARQL-style question seeds and rewritten into four related queries.

recordSet.name: spinach_en
recordSet.description: Rows from spinach.tsv. Each row includes a source SPARQL identifier plus four related questions and an optional type label.

field.name: spinach_en/usparql
field.description: Identifier for the SPARQL seed query or source example.

field.name: spinach_en/Q3
field.description: Question targeting a constrained subset of Q1.

field.name: spinach_en/type
field.description: Optional relation type label as stored in the TSV.

rai:dataUseCases: Evaluation of LLM consistency on SPARQL-seeded QA questions expressed as related natural-language variants.
Analysis of answer-set subset and complement behavior under structured query rewrites.
Not recommended as a standalone training set for general QA.
rai:dataBiases: Source coverage is influenced by the underlying SPARQL seeds and associated knowledge-base content.
Structured question rewrites may be cleaner and more regular than real user requests.
rai:dataLimitations: The subset is small and benchmark-oriented.
Natural-language realization of structured constraints may still leave ambiguity in some items.
The English-only release does not support multilingual evaluation claims.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The released file contains benchmark questions and identifiers only and is not intended to include personal or sensitive user data.
rai:dataSocialImpact: This subset can improve evaluation of consistency in QA systems, especially for structured-query-derived prompts. It should not be used as a sole basis for broad claims about safety, fairness, or truthfulness.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: SPINACH subset curation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: SPARQL-seeded source items were rewritten into Q1-Q4 consistency probes and stored with source identifiers.
